prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: standalone photographic asset for the left image frame of the Maleny Cuisine testimonial section
Primary request: Create a fresh, photorealistic editorial food still life featuring exactly the three supplied Maleny Cuisine jars, using the three reference images as strict product-identity references. The jar packaging, black lids, glass proportions, label artwork, logo, spelling, and visible product names must remain accurate and recognisable.
Input images: Image 1 is the strict product reference for "APPLE FIG & GINGER Chutney" 280g; Image 2 is the strict product reference for "CARAMELISED ONION Marmalade" 300g; Image 3 is the strict product reference for "CHILLI Jam" 300g. Preserve their actual labels; do not redesign or paraphrase them.
Scene/backdrop: a warm sunlit Australian kitchen table beside a bright window, natural ivory woven linen tablecloth, softly blurred pale ceramics and green leaves in the distance
Subject: exactly three supplied jars standing upright as the focal row, all fully visible and label-forward; natural accompaniment of red/purple grapes, halved ripe figs, and a wedge of firm pale cheese on a simple wooden board
Style/medium: premium natural editorial food photography, believable glass, preserve the supplied real labels with high fidelity, settled and unhurried rather than rustic-market styling
Composition/framing: horizontal landscape image, approximately 7:6 ratio, three jars across the middle with breathing room at all edges; apple fig ginger left, caramelised onion centre, chilli jam right; slightly eye-level tabletop view, clear front labels, subtle foreground ingredients, no text overlay
Lighting/mood: warm late-morning sunlight, soft side/back light through glass, gentle realistic shadows, bright cream and fig-brown world, appetising but not glossy or over-styled
Color palette: ivory linen, warm amber preserves, burgundy grapes and figs, pale cheese, quiet leafy green bokeh
Materials/textures: real woven linen, transparent glass, black metal lids, fruit skin, crumbly cheese, lightly worn wood
Text (verbatim on product labels only): "MALENY CUISINE"; "APPLE FIG & GINGER"; "Chutney"; "280g"; "CARAMELISED ONION"; "Marmalade"; "300g"; "CHILLI"; "Jam"; "300g"
Constraints: use only the three supplied products; labels must be accurate and front-facing; no people; no hands; no review copy; no headline; no buttons; no arrows; no carousel controls; no invented products; no extra jars; no watermark
Avoid: altered logos, fake label claims, malformed jars, duplicate jars, unreadable or misspelled labels, excessive flowers, dark moody lighting, rustic burlap, visual clutter, footer-style dark photography
